depiction.primary_object: open hand tilted diagonally with fingers together
modifiers: two curved motion arcs at opposite corners
depiction.composition: tilted open palm flanked by curved motion lines

readings.meaning: waving hand / greeting / welcome / hello or goodbye

ambiguity: Could be read as a general hand or palm print, a slapping motion, or a gesture-control icon at small sizes.

modifier_semantics.modifier: two curved motion arcs at opposite corners

task_intents: welcome new team member or neighbor

reasoning: Shows a tilted open hand with two curved motion arcs indicating a wave. It is a universally understood cue for greetings, welcomes, introductions, farewells, and sign-language or gesture tasks, while distinct from a static stop-hand or grab icon.
